name: toolradar-mcp
description: MCP server for Toolradar: recommend, search, compare, and get verified pricing for 8,600+ software tools. Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible AI assistant.
author: Toolradar <hello@toolradar.com>

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:mcpb: npm run build && rm -rf mcpb-build && mkdir -p mcpb-build/server && cp dist/index.js mcpb-build/server/index.mjs && cp mcpb/manifest.json mcpb/icon.png mcpb-build/ && node -e "const p=require('./package.json');require('fs').writeFileSync('mcpb-build/package.json',JSON.stringify({name:p.name,version:p.version,type:'module'}))" && npx --yes @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack mcpb-build toolradar.mcpb
